privacy.intro: Slot Database (the “service”) respects your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it and what your rights are. By using the service you accept this policy to the extent it applies together with applicable law.
privacy.controllerBefore: The service is provided by Adrian Palomera Sanz. For data-protection queries you can use the
privacy.dataLead: We process the information needed to provide collection management, timings, competitions, inventory and related features:
privacy.dataAccount: email address and profile data linked to sign-up and sign-in (for example a user identifier and metadata you allow us to store).
privacy.dataAppLabel: Data you enter in the app:
privacy.dataApp: information about vehicles, timings, circuits, inventory, competitions, participants and any other content you upload or generate when using the service.
privacy.dataTech: session identifiers, security logs needed for the API, and — if you accept non-essential cookies — performance metrics and aggregated analytics to improve the service.
privacy.purpose: Data is processed to perform the service contract (managing your account and the content you store), to meet legal obligations where they apply, and where appropriate for the legitimate interest of security and service improvement. Analytics cookies are based on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time from “Manage cookies” in the footer.
privacy.cookiesLead: We use cookies and local storage according to your preferences:
privacy.cookiesNecessary: session, authentication and basic operation of the application.
privacy.cookiesFunctional: preferences you choose to enable in cookie settings.
privacy.cookiesAnalytics: usage and performance metrics (for example Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights) only if you accept that category.
privacy.processorsLead: To operate the service we use providers that process data on our behalf or as independent controllers, as applicable:
privacy.vercelRole: hosting and, if you accept analytics, usage and performance metrics.
privacy.noSell: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with third parties when it is needed for the service, required by law, or with your explicit consent.
privacy.retention: We keep data while your account is active or as needed for the purpose it was collected. After account deletion we apply the erasure or anonymisation periods that technology and applicable law allow.
privacy.rights: You may exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability where they apply, and withdraw consent for processing based on it. You can use the in-app features or contact us through the channels indicated. If you live in the EU you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.
privacy.changes: We may update this policy. Material changes will be published on this page with a new update date. If the law requires it, we will inform you by appropriate means.
privacy.contact: To exercise your rights or ask privacy questions, use the contact channels published in the application or on the service website when they are available.

terms.accept: By accessing or using Slot Database (the “service”) you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. Continued use after changes are published means you accept the applicable modifications.
terms.desc: Slot Database is a web application for managing slot-car collections, timings, circuits, parts inventory, competitions and related features. The service may evolve: features can be added, changed or withdrawn. Availability is not guaranteed at 100%; interruptions may occur due to maintenance, technical causes or force majeure.
terms.account: To use features that require registration you must provide accurate data and keep your account secure (for example password and devices). You are responsible for activity on your account unless you show unauthorised access and tell us without undue delay.
terms.content1: You retain ownership of the data and content you enter (vehicle sheets, timings, inventory, etc.). You grant us the licence needed to host, process and display them according to the service features (including sync, provider backups and display in interfaces you enable, such as competitions or public profiles when they exist and you configure them that way).
terms.content2: You agree not to upload illegal information, content that infringes third-party rights or that breaches applicable law. We may remove content or restrict access if there is a reasonable indication of breach or if an authority so requires.
terms.ip1: The software, design, structure, documentation, trade marks, trade names and other distinctive elements of the service (including the name “Slot Database” when used as a sign of the service) belong to the service provider or its licensors and are protected by applicable law. All rights not expressly granted in these terms are reserved.
terms.ip2: You are not licensed to copy, modify, distribute, decompile, reverse-engineer, create derivative works or exploit the code or assets of the service beyond the permitted end-user use through the application and API as expressly provided. Any other use requires prior written agreement.
terms.ip3: The above does not limit the rights you have as owner of the content you enter in the service, under the “User content and data” section.
terms.prohibited1: Use the service in a way that may damage, overload or compromise the security of systems or other users.
terms.prohibited2: Attempt unauthorised access to data, accounts or infrastructure of the service or third parties.
terms.prohibited3: Use the service to distribute malware, spam or unlawful content, or content that constitutes harassment, hate or threats.
terms.prohibited4: Reverse-engineer or perform unauthorised mass automated extraction (abusive scraping).
terms.liability: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, to the extent permitted by law. We do not guarantee specific results or the total absence of errors. We are not liable for indirect damages or lost profits unless mandatory law provides otherwise. In any case, where the law allows, aggregate liability is limited to what is reasonable in relation to free or paid use of the service, as applicable.
terms.suspension: We may suspend or close accounts that breach these terms or the law. You may stop using the service and request account deletion using the options available in the application. After deletion, the retention and erasure policies in the privacy policy apply.
terms.changes: We may change these terms. We will publish the updated version on this page with the update date. Material changes will be communicated by reasonable means (for example a notice in the service or an email to your account address) when required.
terms.law: Unless the consumer law of your country requires otherwise, these terms are governed by Spanish law. The competent courts are those that correspond under that law, without prejudice to the mandatory rights you may have as a consumer.
